description: This Java source file defines the ConceptReferenceTermSaveHandler class which implements save handling logic for ConceptReferenceTerm objects within the OpenMRS platform. It sets the termA field for associated ConceptReferenceTermMap objects during save operations, and is integrated with OpenMRS's AOP framework for automatic invocation.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermSaveHandler
classes.description: Implements SaveHandler to manage save operations for ConceptReferenceTerm objects, specifically setting termA in associated ConceptReferenceTermMap objects.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Sets the concept reference term as termA in all ConceptReferenceTermMap objects associated with the given ConceptReferenceTerm during save operation.
